WITH per_currency AS (
  SELECT
    feecoin,
    AVG(NULLIF(rebtotal, 0)) AS avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN rebrate <> 0 AND feerate <> 0
        THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate
      END
    ) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS mean_avg_rebtotal
  FROM per_currency
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT p.avg_rebtotal, p.avg_relative_gap, b.mean_avg_rebtotal
  FROM per_currency AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_rebtotal > b.mean_avg_rebtotal
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate,
  AVG(avg_relative_gap) AS avg_relative_rebate_to_fee_gap,
  AVG(avg_rebtotal - mean_avg_rebtotal) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;
